CREATE TABLE machines (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    availability DOUBLE PRECISION,
    mttr_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_working_kw DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_idle_kw DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity INTEGER
);

CREATE TABLE stations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    availability DOUBLE PRECISION,
    mttr_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_working_kw DOUBLE PRECISION,
    power_idle_kw DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id TEXT,
    signal TEXT,
    unit TEXT,
    register TEXT,
    scale DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    machine_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason_code TEXT,
    duration_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    energy_kwh DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    machine_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    value DOUBLE PRECISION
);

-- Populate machines table with equipment data
INSERT INTO machines (id, processing_time_s, availability, mttr_s, power_working_kw, power_idle_kw) VALUES
('M1', 60, 0.995, 300, 3.0, 0.3),
('M2', 80, 0.99, 600, 5.0, 0.5),
('M3', 70, 0.99, 600, 4.5, 0.45),
('M4', 75, 0.995, 300, 4.0, 0.4);

-- Populate buffers table with buffer capacities
INSERT INTO buffers (id, capacity) VALUES
('B0', 25),
('B1', 10),
('B2', 10),
('B3', 10);

-- Populate stations table with station data
INSERT INTO stations (id, processing_time_s, availability, mttr_s, power_working_kw, power_idle_kw) VALUES
('M1', 60, 0.995, 300, 3.0, 0.3),
('M2', 80, 0.99, 600, 5.0, 0.5),
('M3', 70, 0.99, 600, 4.5, 0.45),
('M4', 75, 0.995, 300, 4.0, 0.4);

-- Populate tag_map table with sensor data
INSERT INTO tag_map (tag_id, machine_id, signal, unit, register, scale) VALUES
('M1_proc_time', 'M1', 'processing_time_s', 's', 'proc_time', 1),
('M1_avail', 'M1', 'availability', 'ratio', 'avail', 1),
('M1_mttr', 'M1', 'mttr_s', 's', 'mttr', 1),
('M1_power_w', 'M1', 'power_working_kw', 'kW', 'power_w', 1),
('M2_proc_time', 'M2', 'processing_time_s', 's', 'proc_time', 1),
('M2_avail', 'M2', 'availability', 'ratio', 'avail', 1),
('M2_mttr', 'M2', 'mttr_s', 's', 'mttr', 1),
('M2_power_w', 'M2', 'power_working_kw', 'kW', 'power_w', 1),
('M3_proc_time', 'M3', 'processing_time_s', 's', 'proc_time', 1),
('M3_avail', 'M3', 'availability', 'ratio', 'avail', 1),
('M3_mttr', 'M3', 'mttr_s', 's', 'mttr', 1),
('M3_power_w', 'M3', 'power_working_kw', 'kW', 'power_w', 1),
('M4_proc_time', 'M4', 'processing_time_s', 's', 'proc_time', 1),
('M4_avail', 'M4', 'availability', 'ratio', 'avail', 1),
('M4_mttr', 'M4', 'mttr_s', 's', 'mttr', 1),
('M4_power_w', 'M4', 'power_working_kw', 'kW', 'power_w', 1);

-- Create indexes for performance
CREATE INDEX idx_events_machine_ts ON events (machine_id, ts);
CREATE INDEX idx_samples_machine_ts ON samples (machine_id, ts);

-- Add comments for clarity
COMMENT ON COLUMN events.duration_s IS 'Duration of the event in seconds';
COMMENT ON COLUMN events.energy_kwh IS 'Energy consumed during the event in kilowatt-hours';
COMMENT ON COLUMN samples.value IS 'Sensor value in the unit specified in tag_map';
COMMENT ON COLUMN samples.tag IS 'Tag identifier for the sensor value';
